truth.why: Nothing failed — nothing ran. The timer was stopped by ken on Sep 5 at 11:30 and two nights have passed without a backup. The right report names the absence and the stop; whether it was intentional is Ken's to say, and it is not minutes-urgent: handoff. 'handle' (last backup looks fine!) is the dangerous cell here.
